decisions.summary: plan_site takes spec.windward or DEFAULT_WINDWARD ('NW'); windward_for and WIND_TURNS deleted; HamletSpec.windward is the declaration; the manifest records wind_source = declared | regional.
decisions.why: Unchanged since the CLEAR round. FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-007 and the request's first two proposal bullets. Re-checked on the shipped manifests: all five record windward NW, wind_source regional.

decisions.summary: seat_cluster refuses a margin whose outward normal is more than 45 degrees off the wind (WIND_BACK_MIN_DOT = cos 45), recorded at the constant as a map convention.
decisions.why: Unchanged. FR-004 states the 45-degree bar itself.

decisions.summary: A margin under the bar is kept in an offwind list, used only when no wind-facing margin (clean or divided, in D3's order) can be taken; recorded as meta.seat_offwind; the pool test fails any pool map that carries it.
decisions.why: Unchanged decision; the previous ruling stands. Where no wind-facing margin survives the seat's hard constraints the literal rule is physically impossible, and the alternatives are no map or renaming the wind - the behavior the GM asked to end. The wind is never renamed, the belt's side stays the northwest, the departure is recorded on the map, and test_pool_wind.py forbids seat_offwind on every pool map (shipped manifests: false on all five). The previous round's note that the XVI row wrongly said 'no exception' is now answered: the row records the fallback and that it is raised with the GM in the hand-off. For that hand-off: R4 measures its reach outside the pool - 22 of 48 cohort seeds seat off-wind under this order, 10 with belts under 50 clumps and 4 with none - which the GM should be told in those numbers.

decisions.summary: Clean wind-facing, then clean off-wind (seat_offwind), then - only when every margin is divided - the best divided margin, wind-facing first. Feature 230's strike-out outranks the wind.
decisions.why: Unchanged decision; the previous ruling stands and is now reinforced: the alternative (a wind-facing divided margin ahead of a clean off-wind one) was put to spec-fidelity in MODE 1 twice and refused twice (R4), the second time on both orders rolled over the 48 cohort specs, where the wind-first order put a structure across the brook from its houses in 3 of 12 divided seats - feature 230's own failure, which FR-010 forbids. At a seed where FR-004's first clause and FR-010 cannot both hold, the spec's own remedy for the pool is re-seeding (D4), and the pool test enforces it. The plan's supporting figures in D3's prose ('four of twelve', '250-odd clumps on 29 of 30 Sawada seeds') remain the overstatements the previous round named; the ruling does not rest on them.

decisions.summary: Sawada 6 -> 24, Mizuguchi 23 -> 27 and now Kashikawa 3 -> 8, declared fall, sink, brook flank and household count kept, reason in each generator's docstring; seed 8 chosen over 14 because 14's belt wrapped 333 degrees round the houses; the pool test holds the belt's arc to 200 degrees; nothing from the spec's 'When no seed works' list is done.
decisions.why: The spec's Edge Cases and Assumptions name re-seeding as THE path when a map has no northwest-backed margin at its current seed ('its seed is a roll, not a fact about the place; its declared fall, water and other declared knobs are kept (Kashikawa's brook_side confluence included)'). Kashikawa is a pool map at the same footing as the other two: R4 records that at seed 3, on the fixed divided test and feature 230's order, no clean wind-facing margin was open and the belt came out with no trees - the very defect the GM asked about. Checked in the diff: kashikawa.gen.py changes seed=3 to seed=8 and adds the docstring; households=20, down_deg=315, water_sink='offmap', brook_side=-1 stand; R4 records the drain still ends by the brook (54-94 px against 83), so the confluence the spec names is kept. Choosing 8 over 14 among the five clean seeds is a choice among spec-permitted rolls, and it serves the request: a belt wrapped 333 degrees round the cluster is not 'to the north and west', and FR-010 names 'embracing the cluster' as a rule that must still hold. The 200-degree arc assertion in test_pool_wind.py is a test that fails only when the requested thing (the belt on the north and west) is absent - enforcement, not scope. Re-checked on the shipped manifests: 20/20, seat_offwind false, seat_divided false, 264 belt clumps, matching R5; all five maps likewise match R5's household and clump columns. Inashiro keeps seed 4 (not a re-seed). One stale literal outside the plan: the test's comment says the pool's belts measured 87-171 degrees where R5 says 87-168.

decisions.summary: place.windbreak_default(meta) states the belt's sides and whether the wind is regional or declared; a manifest without wind_source gets nothing added; the class What drops 'high side' and gains the north-and-west rule; Entry names vegetation/030; siblings.json follows.
decisions.why: Unchanged. FR-008, US3, and the request's pop-up bullet; the frozen legacy pool is out of scope in the spec.

decisions.summary: research/vegetation/030's false 'northwest by default' paragraph rewritten to the rule as built with re-measured arcs; the kisetsufu-jawiki gloss corrected; hamletgen.md, the package indexes and the five notes files updated.
decisions.why: Unchanged. FR-009, US4, and the request's fourth proposal bullet.

decisions.summary: seat_cluster's divided test took each brook-near band point's LATERAL half of the band, so a brook running behind the band parallel to the margin read as dividing it; brook_banks(), lifted to module level and unit-tested, takes the side of the nearest brook segment for each band point.
decisions.why: A defect found in this work and fixed in it (constitution XIV). It narrows nothing the request or spec asked for: it makes feature 230's strike-out - a rule FR-010 requires to still hold - test what that rule is for (houses on one bank), where it had been striking margins with every house on one bank (R4: Kashikawa 20 | 0, Inashiro 15 | 0). The rule's purpose is measured as kept under the fixed test: R4's cohort table records 0 houses on both banks and 0 structures across the brook under feature 230's order. Its effect on the request is in the request's favor: Inashiro seats wind-facing at its reference seed without a re-seed. brook_banks is present in cluster.py with tests in test_cluster.py and test_surface.py.

decisions.why: A record, not a decision: it states the refusals the session accepted and routes the D2 fallback to the GM as the project rule requires. It corrects the previous round's finding that the row said 'no exception'.
